spans.s: सजन (I) a. (f. ना) Having men or living beings.
सजन (II) m. A man of the same family, a kinsman.
सजन (I) a. (f. ना) Having men or living beings.
सज्जन (I) n. 1. Fastening; 2. arming, preparing; 3. dressing; 4. guard; 5. a ferry, a ghāt.
सज्जन (II) m. See under सत्.
सज्जन m. a good man, a virtuous man.
सज्जना f. Decorating, ornamenting.
सजाति a. 1. Of the same kind or species; 2. like, similar.

सजुस् (II) m. (nom. सजूः, सजुषौ, सजुषः) A companion.
सजुस् (III) ind. With, together with.
सज्ज a. (f. ज्जा) 1. Armed; 2. fortified; 3. got ready; 4. prepared, ready to meet, e.g. तत्रापि सज्जा वयम्; 5. ornamented, dressed.
